What to write: Short and clear: brand + item type + key detail + size. Vinted also uses the title words to suggest a category.

What to write: Buyers see the first words first. Start with brand, item type, size and colour.

What to write: Fit, measurements in cm, fabric, how many times worn, every flaw and where it is, and if it comes from a smoke-free or pet-free home only when true.

What to write: Up to 5. Use words buyers type that are not already in your text: style, era, occasion.

What to write: Pick the most exact one, all the way down. It decides which other fields you can fill in.
